hypothesis: Removing a direction associated with repetitive student reasoning, contrasted against a verified successful teacher trace replayed through the student, may reduce loops without gradient training.

data.source: Only GSM8K public selections named in the downloaded validation manifest
data.document_verification: SHA-256 of sorted compact UTF-8 JSON, ensure_ascii=false
data.selection: Shuffle the 64 public manifest positions with random.Random(42); first four development, next four holdout. Freeze before inference.

generation.note: Public diagnostic proxy, not official GSM8K fewshot scoring or full 8192-token evaluation. Parent and candidate use identical settings.

loop_diagnosis.note: Token-limit exhaustion alone does not count as repetition. Check detected traces before deriving an edit.

edit.direction: Student-space mean MLP-output difference between repeated student tokens and reasoning tokens from a correct, nonrepeating teacher answer replayed through the student; normalize each layer direction.
edit.column_ranking: Absolute projection of column onto direction multiplied by RMS input activation on loop tokens
edit.operation: Subtract 0.5 * outer(direction, direction @ selected_columns), capped at 0.5 percent of the full tensor Frobenius norm before BF16 rounding
edit.stop_condition: No clear repetitive student trace paired with a verified correct nonrepetitive teacher trace means no supported edit; report the negative diagnosis rather than fabricate one.

validation: Evaluate candidate once on fixed development and holdout with matched generation seed/settings
Report final-answer correctness, repetition coverage, completion and truncation separately
Preserve original model and delta-model.json; save candidate separately
Build and validate patch and verify exact reconstruction if an edit is produced
Open a separate research PR with code, hashes, parameters, seeds and honest findings
Ask for explicit quota approval before any submission
continuation_authorization: User requested continue; use remaining original two-hour window, not a new budget.

protocol_amendment.reason: Teacher failed to finish at 1536 tokens; extend one diagnostic query while retaining original student comparison and single candidate rule.

fallback_rationale: Before receiving the extended teacher result or constructing any candidate: if no complete successful teacher response exists, use the already inspected first correct arithmetic derivation on public example 421 as a weaker contrast. Preserve full-response score zero; verify all arithmetic and public answer; no changes to weight-edit parameters or comparison examples.
